run.name: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CLF)
run.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs' credit is a leveraged cyclical recovery: total debt to LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 7.93x, interest cover of 1.84x on cash interest and liquidity of $3,246 million, with no senior note due before 2029 but a 2028 ABL. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CLEVELAND-CLIFFS INC..

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Total EBITDA, as reported, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 7,712 (10-Q Q3 page:15), cash 77; LTM Adjusted EBITDA 972 = 37 + 993 - 58. Adjusted EBITDA is a management non-GAAP measure that includes non-service pension and OPEB credits; excluding them would raise the multiples (see Interpretation)

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 972 over LTM cash interest 529 = 459 + 411 - 341 (10-Q Q3 page:9). Cash interest excludes finance lease interest and may differ from interest expense by timing of coupon dates; over net interest expense of 604 the cover is 1.61x

cash.basis: Cash. Cash (10-Q Q3 page:3). Borrowing base 4,060 less borrowings 834 less letters of credit 57 (10-Q Q3 page:15). Cash plus capacity is 3,246, stated by the issuer as "$3.2 billion in liquidity" (10-Q Q3 page:46)

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Ratings, covenant terms, indentures, ownership and the sources of expected debt reduction are not supplied, and the improved view rests on one strong quarter.

CP-1 main limitation: Leverage rests on management's Adjusted EBITDA, which was thin before the 2026 recovery. Covenant levels, indentures and the property sale behind expected debt reduction are not supplied.
